items.title: MPs Demand Additional Compensation For FDS Crash Families Beyond Ex-Gratia
items.summary: Bandar Kuching MP Kelvin Yii and Stampin MP Chong Chieng Jen want substantial compensation for families of the five victims in the Long Lellang crash. Yii says the compensation must be on top of ex-gratia payments. Chong says it should be at least RM100k. items.summary: After complaints from two Miri families, a third victim's family in the FDS chopper crash, pilot Captain Zainol Afiq's widow, has denounced MOH's silence and lack of support, saying Layang Layang Aerospace "paid for everything". items.title: Allocate Borneo Medical Service Package In Budget 2027 — Dr James Jeremiah
items.summary: The federal Budget 2027 should fund a Borneo Medical Service Package to attract doctors to serve in Sabah and Sarawak. Both state governments should also allocate funding for state allowances or bonuses and to improve staff accommodation for doctors. The post Allocate Borneo Medical Service Package In Budget 2027 — Dr James Jeremiah appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Borneo No-Shows: Doctors Today Have Other Choices — Physician
items.summary: If Sabah and Sarawak want to attract doctors, make them want to come. The state governments should top up their federal basic salaries by 30% to 40%, besides providing Cola/housing/regional allowances at RM6,000 a month. Fund three return flights yearly.
